name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Merit Scholarship for students studying in 11th & 12th standard of VJNT & SBC category.
description: • Creating an interest in learning among VJNT / SBC students. • Making financial assistance available for education. • Increase the quality of VJNT / SBC category students. • Only VJNT and SBC category students can avail this merit wise scholarship.

evidence.quote: 1) Applicants should belong to Vimukta Jatis, Nomadic Tribes or Special Backward Class.

criteria.label: 2) Applicant must be studying in 11th and 12th standard in Jr. College.

evidence.quote: 2) Applicant must be studying in 11th and 12th standard in Jr. College.

criteria.label: 3) There will be no income limit for this Scholarship.

evidence.quote: 3) There will be no income limit for this Scholarship.

criteria.label: 4) Applicant should have to secure 75% and above marks in 10th standard Examination.

evidence.quote: 4) Applicant should have to secure 75% and above marks in 10th standard Examination.

criteria.label: 5) Scholarship benefit can be taken in addition to Post Matric Scholarship.

evidence.quote: 5) Scholarship benefit can be taken in addition to Post Matric Scholarship.

criteria.label: 6) Education gap is not allowed for this scholarship.

evidence.quote: 6) Education gap is not allowed for this scholarship.

criteria.label: 7) Applicant must be residents of Maharashtra.

evidence.quote: 7) Applicant must be residents of Maharashtra.

benefits.text:
1) Applicants studying in 11th and 12th, a scholarship will get Rs. 300 / - per month and for 10 months it will get Rs. 3000.
2) Applicable for Scholarship and Freeship.

evidence.quote: 1) Applicants studying in 11th and 12th, a scholarship will get Rs. 300 / - per month and for 10 months it will get Rs. 3000.

documents.name: 1.Caste certificate- should be issued by competent authority(certified by only Govt. of Maharashtra)

evidence.quote: 1.Caste certificate- should be issued by competent authority(certified by only Govt. of Maharashtra)

documents.name: 2. SSC marksheet or last examination marksheet.

evidence.quote: 2. SSC marksheet or last examination marksheet.

renewal: • The applicant should have to pass the 11th standard examination.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
